resources.parent: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs — Readjustment Counseling Service (Vet Center program)
resources.primary_services: Free, confidential counseling for combat veterans and survivors of military sexual trauma. Individual, group, family, and readjustment counseling in a non-medical setting.
resources.description: Community-based VA counseling center at 951 Eastgate Loop, Suite 300, Chattanooga, TN 37411. Serves combat veterans and MST survivors. Counseling records are kept separate from VA medical records, which matters for a veteran wary of the VA system.
resources.eligibility_req: Any veteran who served in combat or experienced MST. No VA disability rating, VA enrollment, or prior report required. Any character of discharge.
resources.elig_notes: Combat theater service and military sexual trauma both qualify. Male MST survivors served. A veteran can request a specific counselor, including a female counselor.
resources.what_to_bring: Nothing required. DD-214 helpful if he has it.

resources.parent: RAINN, under contract with the DoD Sexual Assault Prevention and Response Office (SAPRO)
resources.primary_services: Anonymous, confidential, 24/7 sexual assault support for the military community. One-on-one help by phone and online chat, plus Safe HelpRoom peer group chat with men-only sessions every Sunday 1:00 to 3:00 PM ET.
resources.description: The DoD's sole hotline for members of the military community affected by sexual assault. Operated by RAINN. Free, anonymous, worldwide. No IP address or transcript is retained. This is the direct answer to a male survivor who says there are no groups for men like him.
resources.eligibility_req: Any member of the military community, including veterans, affected by sexual assault. No rating, enrollment, or report needed. Fully anonymous.
resources.elig_notes: Built for MST survivors. Men-only Safe HelpRoom sessions Sundays 1 to 3 PM ET. Anonymous, no identifying information collected.
resources.phone_to_call: 877-995-5247 (24/7). Online chat and men's HelpRoom at safehelpline.org
resources.what_to_bring: Nothing. No name or documentation needed.

resources.parent: USMMA Sailing Foundation, in partnership with US Sailing
resources.primary_services: Free adaptive sailing camps and maritime education for wounded, ill, and injured service members and veterans. Three-day Basic Training Camps with instruction, boats, equipment, meals, and local transportation covered.
resources.description: National nonprofit that uses sailing for physical and mental wellness, recovery, and camaraderie. Open to veterans of all branches and all ability levels. A strong hook for this veteran because he already loves sailing, and it builds connection without requiring him to talk about the trauma.
resources.eligibility_req: Veterans and service members of all branches, active or retired, all abilities. Application required. Waitlist can be long.
resources.elig_notes: All branches, all abilities. Camps are regionally located and travel and lodging are usually covered. Confirm current discharge policy when applying.
resources.what_to_bring: Just yourself and personal clothing. All sailing and adaptive equipment provided.

resources.parent: PGA of America REACH Foundation / Tennessee Golf Foundation (TGF Chattanooga)
resources.primary_services: Free 6 to 8 week adaptive golf program for veterans, taught by PGA professionals trained in adaptive golf and military cultural competency. Held at the UTC Player Development Facility, 2452 Hickory Valley Rd, Chattanooga, TN 37421.
resources.description: Local chapter of PGA HOPE, the flagship military program of PGA REACH. Golf used for physical, mental, and social rehabilitation. Free to all veterans. Carries an MOU with the VA that allows direct referrals from recreational therapists.
resources.eligibility_req: All veterans and active-duty members, any ability, new or experienced. Reserved for those who have not completed a local PGA HOPE program before.
resources.elig_notes: All ability and experience levels. Free. VA can refer directly under an existing MOU. Confirm current discharge policy at registration.
resources.what_to_bring: Just yourself. Clubs and equipment provided if needed.

resources.primary_services: Free, private, secure self-help mobile app built specifically for survivors of military sexual trauma. Over 30 tools for coping, symptom management, and wellbeing. Works offline.
resources.description: VA-created self-help app for MST survivors. No account, VA enrollment, or rating required. Available free on iOS and Android. Something he controls on his own phone with no appointment and no waiting room.
resources.eligibility_req: Anyone. No VA enrollment or rating required. Free.
resources.elig_notes: Self-directed tool for MST survivors, including men. Fully private.
resources.what_to_bring: A smartphone. Search 'Beyond MST' in the App Store or Google Play.
